says: Beside the name and id already filed, the polite line for an ended tile broke the tile guideline twice more: it was said for the focused tile too, and it added the exit reason. Fixed in the same pull request by the fix round of 2026-11-15: the line is now `<program> in t<n> ended`, with no reason, and it is said only for a tile that is not the drawn focus.
proof: docs/direction/tile-guidelines.md:288 gives the row as `Program ends, unfocused tile | Polite | tracker in t2 ended`; tellEnded at WindowMachine.ts:489 writes the status message without reading focus; spoken.ts:39 appends `(${message.reason._tag})` to the line; the plan's line 313 (docs/plan/lanes/t290-s2-PLAN.md) chose the reason before decision 0543 said next/ follows an approved guideline as written.
cost: A screen reader user hears an end for the tile they are in, and a reason the guideline did not study; not heard on a real screen reader.
